items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Land of Passion, I had my brother Johnny and Debra sing the duet on that record

ctx.x: Yeah, it was released in ’79. It’s showing that the recording dates were between October and December.

Land of Passion. As a matter of fact, it got a Grammy nomination, that track. Let’s see. All three of those up there, they were Grammy nominated. That’s what those plaques are for. I think one is In the Beginning, I think one is Land of Passion, and I can’t remember the other one. Yeah, I started writing a lot of lyrics during that time. I learned something. Having – like I said, lyrics makes that – bridges the gap between people, because they – words are important. So that’s what made those record go. Land of…
